definition: Adjacent sorted numeric SKU observations, including zero steps for duplicate prices.
caveat: Observed sample is not a complete assortment census.

definition: Adjacent product-family median prices sorted by observed median.
caveat: Family composition and sample counts differ by brand.

definition: Numeric SKU count and share in collapsed existing market-specific price bands.
caveat: Analytical tiers are not affordability or willingness-to-pay tiers.

definition: Lowest observed core numeric price minus lowest observed entry/lower numeric price.
caveat: Blank when the snapshot contains no numeric entry/lower-tier SKU.

definition: Lowest observed icon price minus highest observed pre-icon numeric price.
caveat: Visible list-price gap; not evidence of a demand barrier.

definition: Displayed numeric price versus non-numeric/POR or unresolved observation.
caveat: Unresolved does not prove formal price upon request.
